chunks: In what other lore after this will they then believe?

key_terms.حَدِيث: lore, tradition, or discourse; here referring to the divine message or prophetic narration
key_terms.يُؤْمِنُونَ: they believe; from the root of faith and acceptance

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'In what other lore after this will they then believe?'
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores the finality and comprehensiveness of the Quran and the Sunnah, particularly highlighting the Ahl al-Bayt as the living embodiment of this divine message. It serves as a challenge to those who seek alternative sources of authority, affirming that no other guidance surpasses the clarity of the Prophet's tradition. This verse reinforces the concept of 'Tawatur' (mass transmission) in Shia scholarship, validating the reliability of the transmitted hadith.
